👋 Hey, I'm Darin

A technical product designer with a thing for design systems. Currently working on Chop-Chop, my cooking/fitness/health startup and taking contract work. Before that, I spent 4 years working on the future of design tools and the web as one of Webflow's first designers. And in another life before that, I started one of the first dedicated product design agencies in Bulgaria.
